package.name: video_uplink
package.description: Front gimbal camera perception and GCS video uplink: RTSP/H.265 ingest, inference, and tracking (perception_front_node, SDD-MC-001 §9a, FR-080-082/IR-040) and re-encoded video + metadata uplink to the GCS (video_mux_node, SDD-MC-001 §9a, FR-083-084/IR-041-042).
